name: Substrate ASDiv 3-op composition ceiling
description: Substrate-only ASDiv 3-operation arithmetic composition. Maps the architectural reach ceiling. Cycle 238 base: 0.6835 (n=79 3-op problems). Compared with 2-op 0.833 and 1-op 0.721, 3-op DEGRADES with complexity. 3-op failures = implicit constants or non-arithmetic ops requiring world-knowledge augmentation.

solution_history.replacement_reason: First measurement of 3-op architectural ceiling via discriminative perceptron over n-op composition; ceiling 0.6835 establishes reach limit; WK augmentation (PP-394) lifts to 0.7848

name: Substrate ASDiv with WK oracle augmentation
description: Substrate ASDiv with world-knowledge oracle augmentation (rule 8 lex_constants). Cycle 238: 3-op base 0.6709 -> WK 0.7848 (+0.1139 lift); 2-op 0.8141 -> 0.8612 (+0.0471); 1-op 0.6791 -> 0.7122 (+0.0331). WK is LOAD-BEARING for ASDiv 3-op specifically. Asymmetric vs SVAMP (where WK is NEGATIVE).

solution_history.replacement_reason: Base discriminative_perceptron on 3-op ASDiv ceiling at 0.6709
Oracle WK augmentation (10 LEX_constant_* atoms; 131 named values) lifts 3-op +0.1139pp; structurally novel: combines discriminative_perceptron + LEX constant lookup

name: Substrate SVAMP role-asymmetry mechanism
description: Substrate SVAMP with role-asymmetry (target-aligned operand selection + subject/object/transfer-direction features). Cycle 238: 0.3633 vs base 0.2867 = +7.67pp largest single-mechanism SVAMP lift to date. Resolves operand ambiguity that SVAMP asymmetric ops (X-Y, X/Y) introduce. Productive axis for SVAMP unlike WK (which fails for SVAMP).

solution_history.replacement_reason: Base discriminative perceptron over operator features alone at 0.2867 on SVAMP
Role-asymmetry features (target-aligned operand selection + subject/object/transfer-direction) added to discriminative perceptron; +7.67pp validated

name: Substrate SVAMP learned operand-pair selector
description: Substrate SVAMP with learned operand-pair selector (selector-pair-acc 0.6457). Cycle 238: 0.3667 vs heuristic 0.363 = +0.37pp (marginal). Bottleneck is selection PRECISION not coverage. Composes with role-asymmetry (PP-395) at similar accuracy; complementary mechanisms.

solution_history.replacement_reason: Learned selector mechanism (64.6% pair accuracy) edges heuristic by +0.37pp; converges with role-asymmetry approach

name: Substrate POS data efficiency curve (HARD_FAIL low-data claim)
description: Substrate POS learning curve: 25:0.653, 50:0.717, 100:0.754, 250:0.812, 500:0.847, 1000:0.877, 2500:0.911. Near-log-linear; NO efficiency advantage at small N. Low-data efficiency hypothesis REFUTED at n<1000. n90 (90% accuracy) requires ~2500 sentences. Product implication: substrate NLP is NOT few-shot capable; advantage is accuracy+speed at full data.

solution_history.replacement_reason: Maps the POS data efficiency curve via discriminative perceptron; HARD_FAIL low-data efficiency claim; useful product-positioning data
